# Aura Civic Establishment

An exploration of 24/7 overlap and shared spaces with KYC in Brisbane by Luke Nathan Hayes / Strange But True. Everything is still a system in development. 433 Logan Road, Stones Corner is a candidate location. There is no confirmed Dunwich programme. Linked websites and repositories document developing proposals, not confirmed programmes, partnerships or operating arrangements. Calculator outputs are editable planning scenarios. Personal Auras belong to their people; C-Hour has no monetary equivalent.

Read the dated source context and preserve distinctions between historic evidence, developing author proposals and scenario assumptions. Discovery does not grant commercial or AI-training rights.
